## Review checklist (SGP-SCMP-001 §8)

- [ ] Linked issue; impact analysis complete
- [ ] Requirements updated before or with the code; `@implements` / `@verifies` tags present
- [ ] `python3 tools/req_trace.py --check` passes (CI runs it)
- [ ] Code standard (SGP-SCS-001) and static analysis clean, or deviations justified
- [ ] Tests added/updated and traced; CI green
- [ ] No untraced or dead code added
- [ ] Docs updated (manual, CHANGELOG, SECI if tools changed)
- [ ] AI-assisted content identified and fully reviewed (SGP-CB-001 §6)
